recipe.title: Theory Family
recipe.purpose: Organize a field by major explanatory families or schools of thought.
recipe.groupingLogic: Groups should be conceptual families with distinct explanatory stances, not just people or chronology.
recipe.contributorRules: Contributors should be attached to the theory family they shaped, extended, or strongly challenged.
recipe.generationInstructions: Prioritize stable families, central claims, pressure points, and representative contributors. Avoid making one group per person.
evaluationCriteria: Groups are mutually useful rather than cosmetic
